items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I heard Gary McFarland, but I don't really recall anything like that.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear some of the things that Gary McFarland did for string?
I heard Gary McFarland, but I don't really recall anything like that. In what context?
Varied context. He did one record for Zoot with a large string ensemble which was gorgeous.
